description: Topic builder (Go `TopicOf`, `PrefixedTopicOf`, `TopicBuilder.Mod`, `TopicBuilder.Action`; Rust `topic_of`, `prefixed_topic_of`, `modifier`, `action`). The builder is constructed from `source`, `category`, `object` and the optional variadic `ctor_modifiers` (last wins), then `mods` are applied in order (last wins, empty clears), then `action` renders. A modifier joins into the Object segment with `_`; it is not a fifth segment. Rendering validates with the construction-time validator and fails on any violation: Go panics, Rust `action` panics and `try_action` returns the error. `error` is the exact panic text (`bus.TopicOf: ` plus the invalid-topic message); `error_contains` is used only for the not-past-tense case, up to the trailing "see ..." pointer (see README).

cases.name: uppercase action
cases.error: bus.TopicOf: bus: invalid topic: "kit.config.snapshot.Reloaded" (topic "kit.config.snapshot.Reloaded" segment "Reloaded" must be lowercase letters, digits, or underscores)

cases.name: punctuation in modifier
cases.error: bus.TopicOf: bus: invalid topic: "kit.config.snapshot_re-load.failed" (topic "kit.config.snapshot_re-load.failed" segment "snapshot_re-load" must be lowercase letters, digits, or underscores)

cases.name: uppercase modifier
cases.error: bus.TopicOf: bus: invalid topic: "kit.config.snapshot_Reload.failed" (topic "kit.config.snapshot_Reload.failed" segment "snapshot_Reload" must be lowercase letters, digits, or underscores)

cases.name: present-tense action
error_contains: bus.TopicOf: bus: invalid topic: "kit.config.snapshot.create" (topic "kit.config.snapshot.create" action segment "create" is not past-tense (e.g. "started", "created")
